description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy On Fish, Fresh or Chilled etc
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains a regulatory order with specific rates and details for various commodities, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does so only in the context of exercising statutory powers and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
